title: 2 Timothy Chapter 3 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 2 Timothy chapter 3 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 2 Timothy Chapter 3 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 2 Timothy Chapter 3.

questions.question: What will happen in the last days according to 2 Timothy 3?
questions.explanation: The verse states that in the last days perilous times shall come (2 Timothy 3:1).

questions.question: According to 2 Timothy 3:2, what are men said to be lovers of?
questions.explanation: The verse indicates that men shall be lovers of their own selves (2 Timothy 3:2).

questions.question: Which of the following traits is NOT mentioned in 2 Timothy 3:2?
questions.explanation: The verse lists many negative traits but does not mention 'humble' (2 Timothy 3:2).

questions.question: True or False: According to 2 Timothy 3:3, men will be without natural affection.
questions.explanation: The verse states that men shall be without natural affection (2 Timothy 3:3).

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:4 mention as a characteristic of men in the last days?
questions.explanation: The verse lists 'traitors' as one of the characteristics (2 Timothy 3:4).

questions.question: True or False: 2 Timothy 3:5 says to embrace those who have a form of godliness.
questions.explanation: The verse advises to turn away from those who have a form of godliness but deny its power (2 Timothy 3:5).

questions.question: What type of individuals does 2 Timothy 3:6 describe?
questions.explanation: The verse describes those who lead captive silly women laden with sins (2 Timothy 3:6).

questions.question: True or False: According to 2 Timothy 3:7, some people are ever learning but not able to know the truth.
questions.explanation: The verse states that they are ever learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth (2 Timothy 3:7).

questions.question: In what context are Jannes and Jambres mentioned in 2 Timothy 3?
questions.explanation: The verse compares them to those who resist the truth (2 Timothy 3:8).

questions.question: What will be made manifest according to 2 Timothy 3:9?
questions.explanation: The verse states that their folly shall be manifest unto all men (2 Timothy 3:9).

questions.question: In 2 Timothy 3, which instruction comes FIRST regarding how to deal with certain people?
questions.explanation: The instruction to turn away from those who deny the power of godliness comes first (2 Timothy 3:5).

medium.title: 2 Timothy Chapter 3 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 2 Timothy Chapter 3 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What will happen in the last days according to 2 Timothy 3:1?
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:1 states that in the last days perilous times shall come, indicating a period of difficulty and danger.

questions.question: According to 2 Timothy 3:5, what should one do with those who have a form of godliness but deny its power?
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:5 advises to turn away from those who have a form of godliness but deny its power, emphasizing the importance of genuine faith.

questions.question: What characterizes the men mentioned in 2 Timothy 3:2?
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:2 describes men in the last days as lovers of their own selves, highlighting selfishness and pride.

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:12 state about those who live godly in Christ Jesus?
options: They will be free from troubles
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:12 clearly states that all who live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution, a reality of the Christian faith.

questions.question: According to 2 Timothy 3:7, what is true about certain individuals?
options: They are ever learning but never able to come to the knowledge of the truth
They are faithful in their studies
They are quick to share their wisdom
questions.correctAnswer: They are ever learning but never able to come to the knowledge of the truth
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:7 points out that some are always learning yet fail to grasp the truth, indicating a lack of true understanding.

questions.question: What warning is given in 2 Timothy 3:8 about certain individuals?
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:8 warns that those who resemble Jannes and Jambres will also resist the truth, highlighting their corrupt minds.

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:10 emphasize about the speaker's life?
options: He has lived a carefree life
He has fully known doctrine, manner of life, purpose, and patience
He has become wealthy and famous
questions.correctAnswer: He has fully known doctrine, manner of life, purpose, and patience
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:10 emphasizes the speaker's intimate knowledge of his doctrine and character, showcasing his commitment to godliness.

questions.question: According to 2 Timothy 3:9, what will happen to those who resist the truth?
options: They will be accepted by all
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:9 asserts that those who resist the truth will not progress, and their folly will be evident to everyone.

questions.question: True or False: According to 2 Timothy 3:11, the speaker did not face any persecutions.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:11 recounts the persecutions endured by the speaker, affirming that he faced many challenges in his ministry.

questions.question: True or False: 2 Timothy 3:16 states that all scripture is inspired by God and is useful for correction.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:16 affirms that all scripture is given by inspiration of God and is profitable for various aspects of teaching, including correction.

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:14 encourage believers to do?
options: Forget the teachings they have received
Continue in the things they have learned
questions.correctAnswer: Continue in the things they have learned
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:14 encourages believers to persist in the teachings they have received, reinforcing the importance of steadfastness in faith.

questions.question: True or False: Those who will live godly in Christ Jesus will have an easy life according to 2 Timothy 3:12.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:12 states that all who live godly will suffer persecution, indicating that a godly life may lead to challenges.

questions.question: How does 2 Timothy 3:15 highlight the importance of scripture?
options: It is only for church leaders
It makes one wise unto salvation through faith in Christ Jesus
It should be ignored by youth
questions.correctAnswer: It makes one wise unto salvation through faith in Christ Jesus
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:15 emphasizes that the holy scriptures can make one wise unto salvation, showing their vital role in a believer's life.

hard.title: 2 Timothy Chapter 3 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 2 Timothy Chapter 3.

questions.question: In 2 Timothy 3:13, what shall happen to evil men and seducers?
options: They shall wax worse and worse
questions.correctAnswer: They shall wax worse and worse
questions.explanation: The verse states that evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, indicating a decline in moral and spiritual condition (2 Timothy 3:13).

questions.question: According to 2 Timothy 3:16, what is scripture profitable for?
options: Doctrine, reproof, correction, instruction in righteousness
questions.correctAnswer: Doctrine, reproof, correction, instruction in righteousness
questions.explanation: The verse explicitly states that all scripture is profitable for doctrine, reproof, correction, and instruction in righteousness (2 Timothy 3:16).

questions.question: What is the outcome for those who continue in the things they have learned, as stated in 2 Timothy 3:14?
options: They will be assured of their faith
questions.correctAnswer: They will be assured of their faith
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:14 encourages believers to continue in the things they have learned and ensures that they are assured of their knowledge and faith.

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:15 say the holy scriptures can make one wise unto?
options: Salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus
questions.correctAnswer: Salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus
questions.explanation: The verse states that the holy scriptures are able to make one wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus (2 Timothy 3:15).

questions.question: Which literary device is noted in 2 Timothy 3:16 regarding scripture?
questions.explanation: The structure of 2 Timothy 3:16 emphasizes the importance of scripture by enclosing the concept of its usefulness at both the beginning and end of the verse, a technique known as inclusio.

questions.question: According to 2 Timothy 3:11, who delivered Paul from his persecutions?
questions.explanation: Paul states that the Lord delivered him from all his persecutions, highlighting divine intervention (2 Timothy 3:11).

questions.question: True or False: According to 2 Timothy 3:12, all who live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
questions.explanation: This statement is true as 2 Timothy 3:12 explicitly states that all who live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

questions.question: What characterizes the men mentioned in 2 Timothy 3:8 who resist the truth?
questions.explanation: The men resisting the truth are described as having corrupt minds and being reprobate concerning the faith (2 Timothy 3:8).

questions.question: Which other biblical passage reflects the theme of deception found in 2 Timothy 3:13?
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:24 also warns about false prophets and deceivers arising, aligning with the theme of deception in 2 Timothy 3:13.

questions.question: According to the Greek meaning, what does the word 'scripture' (γραφὴ) imply in 2 Timothy 3:16?
questions.explanation: The Greek term 'γραφὴ' refers to sacred writings, emphasizing that scripture is divinely inspired (2 Timothy 3:16).

questions.question: In what manner should one approach the teachings learned according to 2 Timothy 3:14?
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:14 instructs to continue in the teachings learned with assurance, indicating an approach of certainty.

questions.question: True or False: In 2 Timothy 3:9, it is stated that the folly of those who resist the truth will be evident to all men.
questions.explanation: This statement is true as 2 Timothy 3:9 states that their folly shall be manifest unto all men.

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:17 say about the man of God?
questions.explanation: The verse states that the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished unto all good works (2 Timothy 3:17).

theological.title: 2 Timothy Chapter 3 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 2 Timothy Chapter 3 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:1 indicate about the last days?
options: There will be times of peace
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:1 states that in the last days, 'perilous times shall come', indicating a time of danger and difficulty.

questions.question: According to 2 Timothy 3:2, which of the following is NOT mentioned as a characteristic of people in the last days?
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:2 lists various negative traits such as being 'lovers of their own selves' but does not mention being 'lovers of God', which is a contrasting characteristic.

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:5 say about those who have a form of godliness?
options: They are leaders in the church
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:5 states that they have a form of godliness but deny the power thereof, indicating a superficial adherence without true faith.

questions.question: In 2 Timothy 3:7, what is said about those who are ever learning?
options: They are never able to come to the knowledge of the truth
They are wise in their own eyes
questions.correctAnswer: They are never able to come to the knowledge of the truth
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:7 indicates that those who are ever learning are unable to come to the knowledge of the truth, suggesting a lack of true understanding despite their learning.

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:10 emphasize about Paul's life?
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:10 emphasizes that Paul is known for his doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, and patience.

questions.question: According to 2 Timothy 3:12, what can be expected of those who live godly in Christ Jesus?
options: They will be celebrated by all
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:12 states that all who live godly in Christ Jesus will face persecution, affirming the trials that come with true faith.

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:16 reveal about Scripture?
options: It is only for the wise
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:16 declares that all Scripture is given by inspiration of God, affirming its divine origin and authority.

questions.question: What doctrine is suggested by the combination of 2 Timothy 3:5 and 2 Timothy 3:6?
options: The inevitability of sin in believers
questions.explanation: The combination of 2 Timothy 3:5 and 2 Timothy 3:6 highlights the danger of false teachers who lead others astray while appearing godly.

questions.question: What can be concluded about the nature of evil from 2 Timothy 3:13?
options: Evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse
questions.correctAnswer: Evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:13 explains that evil men and seducers will become increasingly worse, emphasizing the progressive nature of evil in the last days.

questions.question: What attribute of God is highlighted in 2 Timothy 3:17 regarding the man of God?
options: His ability to perfect and furnish the man of God
questions.correctAnswer: His ability to perfect and furnish the man of God
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:17 reveals God's attribute of perfection and provision, stating that He equips the man of God for all good works.

questions.question: How does 2 Timothy 3:14 encourage Timothy regarding his teachings?
options: To abandon them for new ideas
To continue in the things he has learned
To share them with no one
questions.correctAnswer: To continue in the things he has learned
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:14 encourages Timothy to continue in the teachings he has learned, affirming the importance of steadfastness in faith.

questions.question: According to 2 Timothy 3:8, who withstood Moses?
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:8 mentions Jannes and Jambres as those who withstood Moses, illustrating the opposition to God's truth.

questions.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:9 promise about the folly of those who resist the truth?
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:9 assures that those who resist the truth shall not proceed further, indicating that their folly will eventually be revealed.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that the Bible is not relevant to modern times. What does 2 Timothy 3:16-17 actually teach?
options: All scripture is inspired and profitable for teaching
Only certain parts of Scripture are useful
questions.correctAnswer: All scripture is inspired and profitable for teaching
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:16-17 teaches that all Scripture is inspired by God and is profitable for doctrine, reproof, and instruction, affirming its relevance.

questions.question: What does the combination of 2 Timothy 3:11 and 2 Timothy 3:12 imply about suffering for the faith?
options: It is a sign of failure
It is a blessing only for some
It should be avoided at all costs
questions.explanation: The combination of 2 Timothy 3:11 and 2 Timothy 3:12 implies that suffering is an unavoidable aspect of living godly in Christ Jesus.
